name: docket
description: A project's docket casebook in Wheelhouse: everything docket open shows and does - Browse, Ask, Adapters, the inspector, chat and sync - drawn from the project's docket viewer, which is also docket's MCP server, whose app draws what docket_search finds on the casebook's board, or the one resource docket_get read as its card; and a Docket page listing every project, with Add Docket for those without one.
